title: Digital Augmentation Of Capabilities
definition: The enhancement of existing capabilities through the integration of digital technologies or services.

difficulty_levels.beginner: Think of this as when you use an app to do something you couldn't do before. It's like having a digital tool that expands your capabilities.
difficulty_levels.intermediate: This concept refers to the process of extending an entity's functionality using digital technology. In the context of the conversation, a platform is augmenting the capabilities of a language model by connecting it to a vision model.
difficulty_levels.expert: Digital augmentation of capabilities involves the integration of artificial intelligence and machine learning techniques to enhance or extend the capabilities of a system. This phenomenon not only expands the functionalities of traditional technology but also raises philosophical questions about the nature of intelligence and the role of technology in human life.

extra_fields.insight: The conversation reveals that a platform has augmented the capabilities of a language model by connecting it to a vision model, enabling it to 'see' and describe images.
